name: io.github.zsraduly77/defi-flow-price-gap
title: DeFi Capital Flow-Price Gap
description: Daily DeFi token signal, first-hand on-chain (not DefiLlama). Bitcoin-timestamped; x402 per call.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Free. Today's data day and its age, the quality gate, whether paid tools are open (paid_routes_open), the Bitcoin proof status of today's fingerprint, the token list (token_symbols) and each tier's track-record verdict. Same JSON as GET /v1/status. Informational, not investment advice.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Free. Track record per signal tier: backtest verdicts (A works / B partial / C not distinguishable from luck) per methodology version, observation counts, the thresholds, Bitcoin proofs, the live record and the price policy. A tier name describes the measured state, not how well it is proven. Same JSON as GET /performance.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Free. What is measured today: chains, protocols, tokens and data sets, generated from the data itself. Same JSON as GET /coverage.json.

tools.name: list_free_days
tools.description: Free. Every data day older than 7 days, free under CC BY 4.0 and byte-identical to the Bitcoin-timestamped originals: date, link to the full signal, fingerprint and Bitcoin status. Compact view of GET /free/index.json.

tools.name: get_free_signal
tools.description: Free. The full daily signal (all tokens: protocol capital inflow vs price gap, tier and reason, holder value fields, risk flag) of a data day older than 7 days, CC BY 4.0, with its proof fields. Argument date: YYYY-MM-DD (see list_free_days). Same JSON as GET /free/{date}/signal.json. Informational, not investment advice.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Free. The SHA-256 fingerprint file and the OpenTimestamps Bitcoin proof of a data day, its Bitcoin status and block, and how to verify it yourself (ready-made code: /examples/). Argument date: YYYY-MM-DD. From GET /verify/index.json.

tools.name: get_token_signal
tools.description: One DeFi token (argument token): daily DeFi token signal: first-hand on-chain flow to its protocol (fixed prices) vs price gap; tier + reason. Not a DefiLlama wrapper. All: /v1/signal $0.01. Bitcoin-timestamped; free proof: /verify/index.json. Not investment advice. Track record per tier (A/B/C, rules fixed in advance and Bitcoin-timestamped) in every response; predictive power not yet proven live. Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base with x402 inside the MCP call (_meta["x402/payment"]); without payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired result and nothing is charged. Same JSON as GET /v1/signal/{token}.

token.description: token symbol, case-insensitive; today: AAVE, COMP, ENA, ETHFI, LDO, MORPHO, RPL, SKY, SYRUP, UNI (also get_status, field token_symbols)

receipt.description: optional: refetch.receipt from an earlier paid answer of the same tool - the same data again without payment (terms 2b)

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Daily DeFi token signal, 10 tokens: first-hand on-chain net flow per protocol (11 protocols, fixed prices) vs price gap; tiers + reasons. Not a DefiLlama wrapper. Bitcoin-timestamped; free proof: /verify/index.json. Not investment advice. Track record per tier (A/B/C, rules fixed in advance and Bitcoin-timestamped) in every response; predictive power not yet proven live. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base with x402 inside the MCP call (_meta["x402/payment"]); without payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired result and nothing is charged. Same JSON as GET /v1/signal.

receipt.description: optional: refetch.receipt from an earlier paid answer of the same tool - the same data again without payment (terms 2b)

tools.name: get_inflow_assets
tools.description: First-hand on-chain DeFi capital flows per protocol and asset (not a DefiLlama wrapper): net deposits/withdrawals at fixed prices, read at one fixed daily block (named in each answer), not TVL moved by price. Aave v3, Compound v3, Ethena, ether.fi, Lido, Maple, Morpho Blue, Rocket Pool, Sky, SparkLend, Uniswap v4 (11 protocols, Ethereum). Bitcoin-timestamped; free proof: /verify/index.json. Not investment advice. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base with x402 inside the MCP call (_meta["x402/payment"]); without payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired result and nothing is charged. Same JSON as GET /v1/inflow/assets.

receipt.description: optional: refetch.receipt from an earlier paid answer of the same tool - the same data again without payment (terms 2b)
